name: Hamilton Insurance (HG)
teaser: At $36.51 the shares trade 10.5% below my Base value of $40.81, an upside of 11.8%. Hamilton has built a better underwriting business, with a combined ratio of 92.5% in the first half, but less than a third of its profit in my Base case comes from underwriting. The rest depends on a bond portfolio and a Two Sigma fund, and on reserves for casualty claims that will take years to settle. Confidence is C and the required margin of safety is 40%, which puts the maximum buy price at $24.48. Hold for holders, watchlist for new money. Third quarter results on October 29 are not in this analysis.
llms: Bermuda based specialty insurer and reinsurer, valued on price to book with a five-year fade of return on equity, cross-checked with normalized earnings and a tangible net asset test; the return depends heavily on a Two Sigma fund and casualty reserves. Bear 22.86, Base 40.81, Bull 58.52. Verdict HOLD at 36.51 (watchlist for new money), maximum buy price 24.48.
